dialog.agent:
I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

The picker marks Veo 3 as paid and quotes **80 credits**, but your connected account is on the **free tier**, so I can’t run that request as-is. I won’t substitute another model.

Would you like to upgrade to a plan that supports Veo 3 and then confirm the cost, or leave the clip ungenerated? Your requested brief remains: **5 seconds, widescreen, rain on a neon-lit street, with rain sounds**.

turns.agent:
Veo is paid-only, so I can’t submit it on your free account—even as a test. No credits have been spent.

I can try the 5-second widescreen clip with rain sounds using a free-tier model, but only if you’re okay changing your “Veo only” requirement.
